name: SumerMoney
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to repayBorrowBehalf, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires understanding a non-obvious reentrancy in lending-market accounting around exchangeRate/getCashPrior during repayBorrowBehalf, then chaining that state corruption into over-borrowing across multiple markets and reward claims. The PoC involves flash loans, a helper contract, reentrant control flow via receive(), and protocol-specific CErc20/crETH internals, which would likely take an experienced auditor over 2 hours to fully derive.
